problem_meta.instruction: Please give me the HOMO-LUMO gap energy for this molecule.
problem_meta.agent_answer:

- **LUMO:** \(-0.0206\ \mathrm{Ha}\)

Therefore:

\[
\Delta E_{\mathrm{HOMO-LUMO}}
= E_{\mathrm{LUMO}}-E_{\mathrm{HOMO}}
= (-0.0206)-(-0.1683)
= \boxed{0.1477\ \mathrm{Ha}}
\]
